name: NATO: an allied tactical air force (composite)
description: A superior air force: a daily air tasking order, packages built around strike flights with suppression, stand-off jamming, decoys and escorts, a long and methodical campaign to roll back the air defences, then interdiction and support of the land battle. Strong ELINT, satellites and reconnaissance; coalition politics, a low tolerance for losses and prisoners, and anti-radiation missiles in short supply.
source: usaf_ato_doctrine and wiki_ato (the daily tasking order and its cycle); jsead_1982 and jp3_01_4_1995 (SEAD: campaign, localized and opportune suppression); afmag_1989_slam (hunter-killer teams, the three ways of jamming, HARM in short supply); decoys (decoy drones before the strike, the Bekaa 1982); every number not named there is a game value
notes: Composite and fictional: the units are not real NATO units. Aircraft types are period types named for flavour; every aircraft number is a PLACEHOLDER (docs/air_war/01_FACTIONS.md).

doctrine.source: usaf_ato_doctrine (a 24-hour order planned ahead: planning_cycle_h, lead_time_h); jp3_01_4_1995 (a theatre-wide suppression campaign first, then localized suppression for each operation); the rest game values

phases.name: air superiority and the rollback of the air defences
phases.notes: Until the intelligence believes fewer than 45% of the air defences still work.

strike.notes: Strike flights with hunter-killer SEAD, an EF-111A standing off, escort against the defender's fighters (afmag_1989_slam).

dead.notes: Decoys first to make the site radiate, ARMs on what radiates, bombs on the located site (the Bekaa: decoys).

hunter.notes: A hunter-killer team on patrol over a suspected battery: fires on whatever radiates (opportune suppression: jp3_01_4_1995).

deception.notes: A wave of decoy drones to drain the battery's missiles and make it radiate for the ELINT.

intelligence.source: vr_1985_plss (stand-off TDOA location of a new emitter within seconds: elint_k_m, elint_delay_h); afmag_2000_kosovo (inflated claims, design reference only: bda_overclaim); satellite passes and latencies are game values (a period source on pass warning is an open item: docs/research/ENEMY_AIR_RESEARCH_2026-10.md section 7)

logistics.source: afmag_1989_slam (HARM in short supply, Shrike older: a stock the rollback spends in two or three days); the numbers are game values (balance pass, docs/air_war/09_BALANCE.md)

politics.source: nmusaf_sanctuaries (no-strike zones and target approval from above); hgram_080 (higher authority setting the time on target: interference_per_cycle); the numbers are game values. The nation's infrastructure kinds (refinery to exchange, 22 Oct 2026) are game values by analogy; a kind of the power grid (substation, dam) is banned wherever power_plant is. The escalation event unbans the whole grid

events.name: Reinforcements
events.text: Two more F-16 squadrons have arrived from across the Atlantic.

events.name: Escalation authorised
events.text: The alliance authorises strikes on the power grid.

events.name: Losses at home
events.text: After a day of heavy losses the capitals order the raids flown above the light flak.

events.name: HARM resupply
events.text: A shipment of anti-radiation missiles arrives.

events.name: Ceasefire talks
events.text: Talks in Geneva: the raids are paused for a day.

officers.name: Thomas R. Halloran
officers.background: USAF fighter pilot, two tours over North Vietnam, staff of Allied Air Forces Central Europe
officers.bio: Learned in Route Package Six what flying into an air defence without suppression costs. Patient, political, ambitious for his fourth star.

officers.name: Dieter Kessler
officers.background: Luftwaffe Tornado navigator, instructor on NATO's Tactical Leadership Programme
officers.bio: Plays chess against the air defence. Never comes the same way twice; likes to make the radars look the wrong way first.

officers.name: Alistair Pryce
officers.bio: Trusts a photograph, distrusts a pilot. Wants fresh imagery of anything that moves before it is struck.

officers.name: Raymond Duquesne
officers.background: F-4G electronic warfare officer, then pilot
officers.bio: Counts every HARM as if it were his last, because in this war it might be.

officers.name: Earl Becker
officers.bio: First in, last out. Takes it personally when a battery kills one of his.

officers.name: Gianni Ferraro
officers.bio: Believes the night and the valleys are a Tornado's best armour.
